alex (partnerships): Heads up — VegaCompute emailed a new capacity + pricing snapshot. Need to fold into the cost model. Can someone confirm ephemeral vs reserved split for Q3? ping @sophie :eyes:

sophie (VegaCompute): Hey team — quick summary below. Numbers in USD, per-GPU-hour. These are firm for the next 30 days; we can lock longer with a 6/12mo commitment.

```
Reserve (monthly committed hours):
- Band A (0-12k GPU-hrs): $0.62/hr
- Band B (12k-60k GPU-hrs): $0.51/hr
- Band C (60k+ GPU-hrs): $0.44/hr

Ephemeral / spot guidance:
- Typical spot fill rate: 58% — 78% depending on region
- Floor spot price (avg): ~35% of Reserve Band A
- Spot can be offered as preemptible pools with 5–12 min average life

Commit terms & flex:
- 6mo term: 3% discount vs listed band
- 12mo term: 8% discount vs listed band
- Convertibility: up to 20% of unused committed hours can be credited to on-demand at quarter close
```

maria (finance): Thanks. Are the band thresholds measured in GPU-hours or instance-hours (some SKUs have 1.5x GPU equivalents)? Also confirm currency/VAT assumptions.

sophie (VegaCompute): Bands are pure GPU-hours (we normalize hybrids). Prices exclude VAT; network/egress is extra and depends on region. We can provide SKU-level multipliers if you want.

josh (pm-pricing): Two quick asks: 1) can we get a CSV with historical spot fill by region (last 6 months)? 2) do you offer a short-term pilot price for a 4-week burst (we need to model ramp costs).

sophie (VegaCompute): Will share CSV. Pilot: yes, we can do a 4-week burst at Band A -10% for first 2 weeks, subject to capacity.

liam (infra): Operational question — what's the lead time to start reserved pools? We need to pre-warm images and KV caches.

sophie (VegaCompute): Lead time typically 48–72 hours for reserved pool activation if capacity is available; for guaranteed windows we recommend 7 days. Pre-warm scripts can be run on our side if you share the image.

deploy-bot: New vendor doc uploaded: https://files.internal/vega/capacity_snapshot_2026-03.csv :sparkles:

alex (partnerships): Awesome — action items: Sophie to drop CSV + SKU multipliers, Josh to define pilot size, Maria to confirm VAT modeling, Liam to note pre-warm ops. I'll update the cost model with Band A/B/C and run sensitivity on spot fill 50–80%. Back in ~48h with deltas. :thumbsup:
